Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns; CJP Activist Abhijeet Dipke Claims Victory

Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post. Following his resignation, CJP activist Abhijeet Dipke released a video stating, "This is just the beginning." Dipke had led a 37-day protest related to the NEET issue. In Parliament, Pradhan, in his first appearance after resigning, received a "hero's welcome" and stated he was a "street fighter" hitting back at Congress MPs. Dipke's parents expressed relief, and Dipke himself thanked supporters.
